record.bible_text: Who hath believed<WH0539><WTH8689> our report<WH08052>? and to whom is the arm<WH02220> of the LORD<WH03068> revealed<WH01540><WTH8738>? <RF>report: or, doctrine?: Heb. hearing?<Rf>

For he shall grow up<WH05927><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him as a tender plant<WH03126>, and as a root<WH08328> out of a dry<WH06723> ground<WH0776>: he hath no form<WH08389> nor comeliness<WH01926>; and when we shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> him, <FI> there is<Fi> no beauty<WH04758> that we should desire<WH02530><WTH8799> him.

He is despised<WH0959><WTH8737> and rejected<WH02310> of men<WH0376>; a man<WH0376> of sorrows<WH04341>, and acquainted<WH03045><WTH8803> with grief<WH02483>: and we hid as it were<WH04564><WTH8688> <FI>our<Fi>  faces<WH06440> from him; he was despised<WH0959><WTH8737>, and we esteemed<WH02803><WTH8804> him not. <RF>we hid...: or, he hid as it were his face from us: Heb. as an hiding of faces from him, or, from us<Rf><CM>

Surely<WH0403> he hath borne<WH05375><WTH8804> our griefs<WH02483>, and carried<WH05445><WTH8804> our sorrows<WH04341>: yet we did esteem<WH02803><WTH8804> him stricken<WH05060><WTH8803>, smitten<WH05221><WTH8716> of God<WH0430>, and afflicted<WH06031><WTH8794>.

But he <FI>was<Fi> wounded<WH02490><WTH8775> for our transgressions<WH06588>, <FI>he was<Fi> bruised<WH01792><WTH8794> for our iniquities<WH05771>: the chastisement<WH04148> of our peace<WH07965> <FI>was<Fi> upon him; and with his stripes<WH02250> we are healed<WH07495><WTH8738>. <RF>wounded: or, tormented<Rf> <RF>stripes: Heb. bruise<Rf>

All we like sheep<WH06629> have gone astray<WH08582><WTH8804>; we have turned<WH06437><WTH8804> every one<WH0376> to his own way<WH01870>; and the LORD<WH03068> hath laid<WH06293><WTH8689> on him the iniquity<WH05771> of us all. <RF>laid...: Heb. made the iniquity of us all to meet on him<Rf>

He was oppressed<WH05065><WTH8738>, and he was afflicted<WH06031><WTH8737>, yet he opened<WH06605><WTH8799> not his mouth<WH06310>: he is brought<WH02986><WTH8714> as a lamb<WH07716> to the slaughter<WH02874>, and as a sheep<WH07353> before<WH06440> her shearers<WH01494><WTH8802> is dumb<WH0481><WTH8738>, so he openeth<WH06605><WTH8799> not his mouth<WH06310>.

He was taken<WH03947><WTH8795> from prison<WH06115> and from judgment<WH04941>: and who shall declare<WH07878><WTH8787> his generation<WH01755>? for he was cut off<WH01504><WTH8738> out of the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>: for the transgression<WH06588> of my people<WH05971> was he stricken<WH05061>. <RF>from prison...: or, away by distress and judgment: but, etc<Rf> <RF>was he...: Heb. was the stroke upon him<Rf>

And he made<WH05414><WTH8799> his grave<WH06913> with the wicked<WH07563>, and with the rich<WH06223> in his death<WH04194>; because he had done<WH06213><WTH8804> no violence<WH02555>, neither <FI>was any<Fi> deceit<WH04820> in his mouth<WH06310>. <RF>death: Heb. deaths<Rf><CM>

Yet it pleased<WH02654><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> to bruise<WH01792><WTH8763> him; he hath put <FI>him<Fi> to grief<WH02470><WTH8689>: when thou shalt make<WH07760><WTH8799> his soul<WH05315> an offering for sin<WH0817>, he shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>his<Fi> seed<WH02233>, he shall prolong<WH0748><WTH8686> <FI>his<Fi> days<WH03117>, and the pleasure<WH02656> of the LORD<WH03068> shall prosper<WH06743><WTH8799> in his hand<WH03027>. <RF>thou...: or, his soul shall make an offering<Rf>

He shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> of the travail<WH05999> of his soul<WH05315>, <FI>and<Fi> shall be satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799>: by his knowledge<WH01847> shall my righteous<WH06662> servant<WH05650> justify<WH06663><WTH8686> many<WH07227>; for he shall bear<WH05445><WTH8799> their iniquities<WH05771>.

Therefore will I divide<WH02505><WTH8762> him <FI>a portion<Fi> with the great<WH07227>, and he shall divide<WH02505><WTH8762> the spoil<WH07998> with the strong<WH06099>; because he hath poured out<WH06168><WTH8689> his soul<WH05315> unto death<WH04194>: and he was numbered<WH04487><WTH8738> with the transgressors<WH06586><WTH8802>; and he bare<WH05375><WTH8804> the sin<WH02399> of many<WH07227>, and made intercession<WH06293><WTH8686> for the transgressors<WH06586><WTH8802>.<CM>
